description: This Java class defines the 'Whoami' command used to retrieve information about the current user within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends a common command class, specifies command type and name, and provides methods for creating instances and handling JSON serialization.

classes.name: Whoami
classes.description: A command class to retrieve current user information within the Ditto gateway service.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new Whoami command with specified headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Whoami command instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new Whoami instance with updated headers.
